Run this workflow manually once. It creates four new ClientReview_Demo34 tables and loads 34 fictional accounts. Original CFTE tables are not used.

Business calendar dates are stored as strings to preserve YYYY-MM-DD. Copy storage_config from Setup complete into Run settings and Reviewer settings in the two other workflows.

Keep Setup unpublished. A repeated setup restores fixture inputs but preserves existing draft/review fields. Setup failures stop visibly in Executions. Setup itself is not evidence of automatic AI processing.
